item.title: Viral 'Coco Chanel' Video Inspires Green Screen Memes And Recreations On TikTok
item.description: Coco Chanel Kid or Coco Chanel Girl is a viral video of TikToker @lacey.m.xxx singing "Chanel" by Tyla while standing on a chair, then falling off of the chair. The video was posted in late November 2025 and went viral in December 2025 as the subject of recreations, lip dubs and memes as an exploitable green screen format.

item.title: Does Your Mom Listen To 'Chicken Alfredo Music?' She Might If She's Made You The Dish Before
item.description: Chicken Alfredo Music refers to an internet slang term and cliché about generic female R&B music that sounds like it would be used as the audio for a Black female influencer's chicken alfredo cooking video.
